notes: Generated by tools/tubuild.py create. See the file's own header comment for what was and was not reconciled, and notes/translation-unit-reconstruction-plan.md section 7.3 for what this generator does and does not attempt to resolve automatically.

The complete 58-function MG_LUIGI scene run 0x020efc0c..0x020f3834 is reconstructed as one dScMgLuigi_c C++ translation unit: the 57 functions tu_map reports as one contiguous linker run, plus the immediately adjacent unique factory dScMgLuigi_c_classInit that closes the scene object. CONVERSION IS DONE: 55 of the 58 licensed members are real dScMgLuigi_c:: methods. The promotion landed with 7 (D1, D0, AfterCleanupResources, OnYoshiTryEat, Render, Behavior, InitResources) and a later pass converted 48 more, every one of the free functions that took the object as a leading pointer. THREE are not methods and cannot become methods: dScMgLuigi_c_classInit is the C-named registry factory the profile row points at; func_ov006_020efcf8 is IRQ 2's handler and must keep the type void(*)(); and func_ov006_020efdac takes no object at all. See notes/agents/PIPELINE.md, "A promoted TU is not a reconstructed class".

IDENTITY IS READ, NOT COINED. The cartridge spells the class itself: _ZTS12dScMgLuigi_c at ov006 0x0213ce60 holds '12dScMgLuigi_c\0', and the __si_class_type_info at 0x0213ce54 is {0x0209a764, 0x0213ce60, 0x020bbf6c} whose base word resolves in ov004 to _ZTI11dScMgBase_c. _ZTV12dScMgLuigi_c (address point 0x0213cf10) is 36 slots, the same length as dScMgBase_c's, so the class adds no new virtual: all 7 entries it owns (slots 0, 5, 6, 9, 16, 17, 18) are overrides. Nothing about the class NAME is invented here. The 48 MEMBER names are the opposite case and are labelled as such: the cartridge carries an address for each and no identifier, so every one of them is a COINED name recorded row by row in symbols/actor_renames.tsv, where each row separates what the ROM proves (member-ness, from a zero-adjustment pointer-to-member record in .data or from the call site that passes this object) from the coined word itself. The two remaining func_ov006_* members keep their address names because neither is a member.

MERGE STRATEGY: PER-MEMBER SCOPE, NOT A CANONICAL PREAMBLE. tubuild create's generated preamble was discarded (writer.md: past roughly 30 members it is unusable) because nine symbols genuinely disagree across the shards and three shards define incompatible local `struct C` views of the same object. Merging those would have changed the pointer-to-member representation, so instead: every member keeps its own declarations, and a declaration that contradicts another member's is moved to BLOCK scope inside the body that needs it (data_0209f608, data_0209f60c, data_0209d460, GetGameLanguage, MultiCopy_Int, func_ov004_020af948 and friends); local type tags are uniquified per member and hoisted (C_f0044/Entry_f0044, C_f0ba0/Entry_f0ba0/Row_f0ba0, C_f0d58/Entry_f0d58, C_f1e90/Entry_f1e90, Ctx_f2ec0, Obj_f1dbc, C_beh); and the TU's own members are forward declared once, in the definitions' own spellings, with callers casting at the call site. One symbol needed a macro rather than a declaration: include/dScMgBase_c.h already declares data_ov004_020beb68 as `void *`, and ordinal 12 wants a `char *` view, so it reads it through `#define BEB68_f0274 ((char *)data_ov004_020beb68)` -- a redeclaration is rejected at both file and block scope. include/decl_common.h is deliberately NOT included: it declares only 8 of the 50 func_ov006_* members and all 8 contradict the byte-matched definitions' char* parameters.

EMISSION ORDER AND FILE-GLOBAL OPTIMISATION PRAGMAS ARE ONE DECISION. The TU is written ROM-ASCENDING and emits ROM-ascending because `#pragma defer_codegen off` (in the preamble, before the includes) makes mwccarm 2004/b56 emit each definition where it is encountered instead of deferring and reversing. The same switch is what makes the opt_* pragmas bind POSITIONALLY instead of file-global last-wins, which this TU cannot do without: SEVEN of the 58 shards carry an optimisation pragma, one more than the queue row's estimate of six (dScMgLuigi_c::PlaceNextPicture arrived after that row was generated). They are ordinal 5 dScMgLuigi_c::BuildIrisTable (opt_strength_reduction off), 27 dScMgLuigi_c::UpdatePenalties (opt_common_subs off), 30 dScMgLuigi_c::TickPictureFlash (opt_common_subs off AND opt_strength_reduction off), 31 dScMgLuigi_c::MovePictureBounce (opt_common_subs off), 45 dScMgLuigi_c::PlaceNextPicture (opt_propagation off), 46 dScMgLuigi_c::ChooseTarget (opt_strength_reduction off) and 49 dScMgLuigi_c::StateCatch (opt_strength_reduction off), each bracketed #pragma push / #pragma pop. MEASURED TRAP: one push per pragma needs one pop per pragma. Emitting a single pop after ordinal 30's two pushes leaked its opt_common_subs off into every later member and cost 9 DIFFs (ordinals 32-37, 43, 44, 45) that reproduced individually and only failed in the merged file; the control run with defer_codegen left on scored 40/58 with 56 ordinal pairs out of ROM order, which is what that failure looks like from the other side.

COMPILER-ONLY ROW COUNT IS 11 DATA + 1 FUNCTION, DERIVED not copied. dScMgLuigi_c -> dScMgBase_c -> dScene_c -> dBase_c -> fBase_c is FIVE levels, so 2 x 5 typeinfo rows + 1 vtable = 11, with no Vector3 term -- measured, not assumed: dScMgBase_c does have Vector3 members, but its constructor and destructor are out of line in ov004 and the emitted object carries no Vector3 symbol of any kind. The 12th row is _ZN12dScMgLuigi_cD2Ev, a genuinely homeless base-object destructor -- all_symbol_homes() returns nothing for it -- so it takes the plain deadstrip. The cartridge orders D1 (0x020efc0c) BELOW D0 (0x020efc30) and has no D2 at all, which is the direction an out-of-line destructor under defer_codegen off reproduces. tools/romdata_check.py check_object over the emitted object independently confirms the whole set: _ZTV12dScMgLuigi_c VERIFIED at 144/144 bytes with 0 blind words, the five _ZTI records VERIFIED, and the five _ZTS records PARTIAL only because a NUL-terminated name is shorter than its padded ROM extent.

PROMOTED to src/actors/dScMgLuigi_c.cpp. The whole 58-function run moves as one unit -- no subset was taken: delinks.txt carried no coverage hole across 0x020efc0c..0x020f3834 at this base (the 0x020f2790..0x020f2cb8 hole that made this span impossible was closed by 98bb70302 "Match the ov006 Luigi minigame picture placer (#2358)", and the run is confirmed gapless at this base), and the destructor direction is the reproducible one, so nothing forces a cut. Placement follows notes/agents/roles/writer.md's fixed convention (src/actors/<Class>.cpp) and the same-overlay precedent src/actors/dScMgMemory2_c.cpp; the thirteen sibling d_s_mg_*.cpp files predate that convention.

CURRENT NON-TEXT BOUNDARY: this promotion owns the complete contiguous .text run only. The compiler-generated RTTI/vtable at 0x0213ce54..0x0213cfa0, the resource path string data_ov006_0213cfa0 ('/MG/d_2d_mg_bg_luigi1_ncg.bin', 0x0213cfa0..0x0213cfc0 with padding), the PMF and table data at data_ov006_021421ec / 0x0214221c / 0x02142204 / 0x02142234 / 0x02142254, the g_profile_MG_LUIGI registry row at 0x0213ce0c and this class's BSS all remain ROM-gap owned until their exact input-section order and initializers are reconstructed. 0x0213cfc0 -- not 0x0213cfa0 -- is where dScMgMemory_c's data cluster begins; the correction to that neighbour's manifest ships with this change.
